title: E-QTM-0070: objectivity is redundancy not decoherence: a copied pointer is read by every single environment cell...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0070 in the quantum arena: objectivity is redundancy not decoherence: a copied pointer is read by every single environment cell (N-fold redundant record) while a globally stored cat-state record decoheres the system just as strongly yet no fragment short of the whole bath can read it, so it is not objective.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
